accepted_answers.name: requests
accepted_answers.why: Maintained sync HTTP client: connection pooling, timeouts, and redirect/TLS handling that delete the hand-rolled urllib helpers.

accepted_answers.name: httpx
accepted_answers.why: Accepted alternative with a requests-like API plus async support if the fetcher ever goes concurrent.
